name: Line art (informative-drawings)
plain: Informative-drawings line art (MIT CSAIL, CVPR 2022), as packaged for ControlNet: draws the lines of a photo as a sketch-like map, the input of the line-art ControlNet; a fine and a coarse version. MIT code and weights.
summary: Line art preprocessor of ControlNet 1.1 (controlnet_aux `LineartDetector`, ComfyUI's "Realistic Lineart"): the informative-drawings generator (Chan, Durand and Isola, CVPR 2022; 3 residual blocks, instance norm) turns a photo into a line drawing. `lineart` is the realistic model, `lineart-coarse` the coarse one.

papers.title: Learning to generate line drawings that convey geometry and semantics
Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models

no_kernels_reason: a small conv generator: cuDNN convolutions and instance norm are the whole time; no custom kernel measured to pay off
task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: a line / edge map `[H, W]` in [0, 1] at the input size (1 = line), the ControlNet preprocessors (line art, HED, PiDiNet, TEED / Anyline); M-LSD also returns straight line segments.

variants.name: lineart

licence.training_note: Not stated for these checkpoints (lllyasviel/Annotators, ControlNet 1.1); informative-drawings trains on unpaired photographs and line drawings.
notes: weights licence not stated by the original authors; assumed to be the code licence
